verdict.rationale: Asking whether a government filing portal's software is open source is a fair question, since agencies can publish their code, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the Secretary of State publishing its portal's source code under an open license. The keyless open-data API on data.colorado.gov is open data, not readable source code, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
